info.title: WalkSafe Android Gateway API
info.description: Single-process Android gateway contract, including server-confirmed integrated consent and durable account-deletion v2 fencing with capability recovery. Every response is Cache-Control: no-store.

get.description: Without a query, returns the current session status and exact session_scope. With exactly devices=true, requires a general-scope current long-lived access cookie and lists only that actor's active devices.

200.description: Current field session state or actor-bound device list

post.description: Body limit 4096 bytes; body-read timeout 10 seconds. Login purpose defaults to general for legacy request compatibility. Short login returns its exact session_scope; account_deletion_recovery is always short-lived and cannot include device_id. An enabled general device login or one-time refresh returns split access-cookie and refresh-token credentials. A consumed refresh-token reuse revokes only that family.

200.description: Short scoped session or general long-lived device session established, or a general device session atomically rotated

Set-Cookie.description: Short-lived walksafe_field_session access cookie; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Secure on HTTPS

delete.description: With device_id, requires a current long-lived access cookie and idempotently revokes that actor's device. Without a query, revokes the current family by access cookie or by the optional JSON refresh proof. Refresh proof values never belong in the URL or headers. A valid, mismatched, or already-revoked well-formed proof returns the same 204 to avoid a token oracle.

204.description: Idempotent revoke accepted; the cookie is expired when the current session is cleared

get.description: Returns the account current live walk. Requires a general-scope v4 long-lived field cookie; holder identity is derived only from that server session.

post.description: Acquires, takes over, renews, or ends the account live walk with a 90 second server-time lease.

200.description: Field walk command applied or idempotently replayed

post.description: Field session required. Body limit 16384 bytes; body-read timeout 10 seconds; upstream timeout 15 seconds.

get.description: Field session required; upstream timeout 15 seconds.

post.description:
Field session required. Total multipart limit 9437184 bytes; body and upstream timeouts are each 15 seconds; one upload may be in flight.

The header purpose must match multipart metadata.auto_reported before any backend fetch.

x-walksafe-report-purpose is an authenticated first-party Android declaration inside the gateway trust boundary, not cryptographic client attestation. The gateway fail-closes when it disagrees with multipart metadata.auto_reported. A tampered but otherwise authenticated client is NOT_COVERED.

image.description: Exactly one JPEG image; 1 to 8388608 bytes

409.description: Consent receipt, actor generation, or processing epoch is stale.

428.description: Required current transport or integrated-consent receipt headers are missing or unsupported.

parameters.name: x-walksafe-network-transport
parameters.description: Current transport; cellular independently requires mobile-network-transfer consent.

parameters.name: x-walksafe-consent-receipt-sha256
parameters.description: SHA-256 receipt for the current consent revision.

parameters.name: x-walksafe-report-purpose
parameters.description: Authenticated first-party Android declaration. explicit requires raw-source consent; automatic also requires automatic-reporting consent.

get.description: Returns the current server-confirmed integrated-consent record. This control form requires exactly control, installation_id, and policy_version query parameters plus the installation control secret. A GET without control parameters serves the separate public privacy-rights HTML page.

put.description: Records four independent consent selections only after a live field session and exact backend consent receipt confirm the mutation. The query contains exactly control=integrated-consent.

post.description: Durably fences the authenticated actor generation before forwarding the exact v2 request. The first request accepts a general or account_deletion_recovery field session and requires a 32-byte client capability; exact retries require only that capability. A 503 means the gateway fence and outbox remain durable but no canonical backend status has been returned.

get.description: Refreshes canonical backend deletion status using only the request-bound recovery capability.

post.description: Durably queues exact, receipt-linked device deletion evidence and forwards it with status-revision CAS. The raw recovery capability is never forwarded or persisted by the gateway.

deletionAccessSecret.name: x-walksafe-deletion-access-secret
deletionAccessSecret.description: Unpadded base64url encoding of exactly 32 random client-generated bytes. Retained only by the Android encrypted fallback marker.

consentControlSecret.name: x-walksafe-consent-control-secret
consentControlSecret.description: Exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters generated and retained by the Android encrypted preference store.

device_id.description: Stable per-install identifier; starts a long-lived device family only when that mode is explicitly enabled and fully configured. Forbidden with account_deletion_recovery purpose.

purpose.description: Authorization scope for a short session. account_deletion_recovery is never device-bound or refreshable.

refresh_token.description: Opaque secret sent only in a JSON request body and returned only in a successful JSON response

items.description: Canonical order: device_untransmitted_data, server_originals, server_quarantine, server_copies, report_records, training_datasets, training_labels, derived_artifacts, backups.

AccountDeletionConflict.description: A stale evidence revision returns the canonical deletion status; request/body/operation/binding and other permanent conflicts return a bounded gateway error and are durably quarantined from retry.

AccountDeletionPending.description: The durable gateway fence or outbox exists, but canonical backend processing is unavailable. Retry with the same request id, body, revision, and capability.
